Two residual causes the 5 blind scorers named repeatedly: (1) HOUSE-STYLE ANCHORING — the panel's house_best reference IS the incumbent (byte-identical), so scorers rate the incumbent 'same-hand' 9 and ANY different-pipeline plate 'lesser'; the gate structurally defines quality AS the incumbent's exact hand, so a new-pipeline plate can rarely clear it regardless of merit.
